source_quote: In the source demo, the expert demonstrates the best practice, explicitly asking the agent to show its work. Like in math class. Exactly. They prompt the agent to use the governed revenue metric located in the sales report semantic model, summarize it by store for a specific time period, explicitly identify the source measure it used, and actually display the underlying query code it executed. So you force the chat interface to show you the exact DAX or SQL code it wrote. Yes. This gives the operator a tangible mathematical calculation. The operator can then take that DAX code and compare it against their traditional legacy power BI dashboard using the exact same filters.
